apiKeyMissing.suggestion: Please go to the settings page to configure the AI API Key

apiKeyInvalid.suggestion: Please check if your API Key is correct, or go to the settings page to reconfigure it

quotaExceeded.suggestion: Your API quota has been exhausted. Please check your account balance or wait for quota reset

rateLimited.suggestion: Please try again later, or reduce the number of questions generated at once

networkError.suggestion: Please check your network connection and try again

timeout.suggestion: The server response timed out, please try again later

invalidResponse.suggestion: The data format returned by AI is incorrect, please try again

databaseError.suggestion: Questions were generated successfully but saving failed. Please check the database connection and try again

unknown.suggestion: Please try again later. If the problem persists, contact technical support
